blocks.text: Welcome to Optimark ("We", "Us", or "Optimark"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our all-in-one digital marketing platform, including our website, applications, and related services (collectively referred to as the "Services").
By accessing or using our Services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use our Services.
The data controller for your personal information is:

items: - PT Usaha Kreatif Indonesia
- Address: company address - to be updated
- Email: admin@usahakreatif.co.id
- Phone: phone number - to be updated

items.html: Account Information: Full name, email address, phone number, company name, and password when you register an account.
Profile Information: Profile photo, job title, and business information you add to your profile.

Payment Information: Data required to process payments, including billing information. We do not store credit card data directly; payment processing is handled through secure third-party payment service providers.
Content and Marketing Data: Content you create, post schedules, advertising campaign data, SEO analysis results, and content generated by the AI Content Maker feature.
Communications: Messages, feedback, and correspondence you send to us through contact forms, email, or customer support features.
Usage Data: Information about how you use the Services, including pages visited, features used, access times, duration of use, and frequency of use.
Device and Technical Data: Device type, operating system, browser type, IP address, unique device identifiers, screen resolution, and browser language.
Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to collect information about your browsing activity. See Section 6 for more information.
Analytics Data: Content performance metrics, user interaction data, and statistics related to your marketing campaigns.

Social Media and E-Commerce Platform Accounts: When you connect Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, Blibli, Shopee, or TikTok Shop accounts to our Services, we receive information from those platforms according to the permissions you grant, including:
Social Login Providers: If you choose to register or sign in using a third-party social media account, we receive basic profile information from that provider.
Business Partners: Information shared by our business partners for the purpose of service improvement.

blocks.text: We use your personal information for the following purposes:

items: Providing, operating, and maintaining the Services
Creating and managing your account
Processing payments and transactions
Connecting and synchronizing data from linked social media and e-commerce platforms
Providing Content Planner, SEO Analyzer, Ads Manager, and AI Content Maker features
Sending Service-related notifications, including content schedule updates and campaign reports
Personalizing your user experience
Developing new features and services
Conducting analysis of usage trends and patterns for Service improvement
Optimizing platform performance and security
Sending technical information, updates, and Service-related notices
Responding to inquiries, support requests, and feedback
Sending promotional information and special offers (with your consent)
Detecting, preventing, and addressing fraudulent activity, abuse, or security breaches
Complying with applicable legal and regulatory obligations
Enforcing our agreements and terms

blocks.text: We process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:

items.html: Consent: When you provide explicit consent for specific data processing, such as direct marketing or use of non-essential cookies.
Contract Performance: When processing is necessary to fulfill a contract with you, including providing the Services you request.
Legitimate Interests: When processing is necessary for legitimate purposes, such as security, fraud prevention, and Service improvement.
Legal Obligation: When processing is necessary to comply with applicable laws and regulations.

items: Purpose: Required for basic Service functionality
Examples: Session authentication, security preferences
Purpose: Remembering your choices and preferences
Examples: Language, display settings
Purpose: Helping us understand how the Services are used
Examples: Google Analytics, feature usage data
Purpose: Used to display relevant advertisements
Examples: Conversion tracking pixels, retargeting

blocks.text: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Services.
7.1 We May Share Your Information With:

items.html: Third-Party Service Providers: Companies that help us provide the Services, including hosting, payment processing, analytics, customer support, and email delivery. These service providers are bound by confidentiality agreements and may only use data according to our instructions.
Connected Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, Blibli, Shopee, and TikTok Shop as required to provide integration features.
Legal Obligations: When required by law, legal process, government request, or applicable regulations.
Corporate Transactions: In the context of mergers, acquisitions, asset sales, or business transfers, your information may be transferred to related parties.

items: Sell your personal information to third parties
Share your personal information for third-party marketing purposes without your consent
Use your information in ways that contradict this Privacy Policy

blocks.text: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, or as required by law. Criteria we use to determine retention periods include:

items: The duration of our business relationship with you
Whether there are legal obligations requiring data retention
Whether retention is necessary for dispute resolution or agreement enforcement

blocks.text: We implement reasonable technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information, including:

items: Data encryption in transit (SSL/TLS) and at rest
Restricting access to personal data to employees who need it
Regular security monitoring
Regular data backups
Security training for staff who handle personal data

blocks.text: However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.
As a user, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
You have the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
You have the right to request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal obligations that require us to retain certain data.
You have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal information in certain circumstances.
You have the right to receive your personal information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
You have the right to object to the processing of your personal information for certain purposes, including direct marketing.
You have the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produce legal or similarly significant effects concerning you.

blocks.html: To exercise these rights, please contact us at admin@usahakreatif.co.id. We will respond to your request within 30 business days at the latest.

blocks.text: Our AI Content Maker feature processes content and instructions you provide to generate marketing content. The following terms apply:

items: Input you provide to the AI feature is used solely to generate the output you request
We may use aggregated and anonymized usage data to improve the quality of our AI models
We do not use AI-generated output to train models shared with third parties without your consent
You are responsible for ensuring that content you create using the AI feature complies with applicable laws and does not infringe third-party rights

blocks.text: Your personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure that international data transfers are carried out with adequate safeguards, including:

items: Use of standard contractual clauses approved by competent authorities
Ensuring that data recipients have an adequate level of data protection
Compliance with applicable data protection regulations in relevant jurisdictions

blocks.text: Our Services may contain links to third-party websites or services that are not operated by us. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those third-party websites. We recommend that you read the privacy policy of every site you visit.

Our Services are not intended for children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child under 18, we will promptly delete that information.

We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on this page with a revised "Last updated" date. We will notify you of material changes through:

items: Email notification to your registered email address
Notification within the Service platform
Announcement on our website

blocks.text: Continued use of the Services after changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.
If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, please contact:
